Preview or explicitly queue a storage-preserving container upgrade

Usage: mj upgrade-container [OPTIONS] --session <SESSION>

Options:
  -i, --instance <NAME>
          Isolate configuration, database, daemon, and logs under `instances/<name>`. This is a different `mj` world, not a harness profile; explicit `MJ_CONFIG_DIR`/`MJ_DATA_DIR` still take precedence [env: MJ_INSTANCE=]
      --session <SESSION>
          Session whose existing container should be inspected or upgraded
      --acknowledge-writable-layer-loss
          Accept loss of writable-layer state after reviewing the image preview
      --no-splash
          Start the dashboard without the animated startup splash, for example over a slow remote connection [env: MJ_NO_SPLASH=]
      --cancel
          Cancel a pending upgrade before replacement starts
  -h, --help
          Print help
